City id washington is a SEPARATE city. Do not invent city=dc, city=washington-dc, city=wmata, or city=us as a second city. Do not merge into any other Next Train city. Agency WMATA Metro. Modes v1: WMATA Metrorail ONLY. No Metrobus, no Better Bus, no DC Circulator, no DC Streetcar, no MARC, no VRE, no Amtrak, no commuter rail.
City stays planned until Jim wires testers. Cut #1 is Rotterdam only. This pack stays planned. assertCityLive("washington") must fail.
Timezone America/New_York HAS DST (EDT/EST). Do not copy Perth / Brisbane no-DST.

Six printed color lines on the current map: Red, Orange, Blue, Silver, Green, Yellow. No seventh line. Map circles print R O B S G Y. Conventional WMATA codes RD/OR/BL/SV/GR/YL recorded as gtfsRouteIdsIfKnown (not extracted from GTFS).

Locked inner-city printed name: Metro Center (Red × Orange/Blue/Silver transfer; rider-tools title Metro Center). Not Gallery Place, not Union Station, not L'Enfant Plaza, not Federal Triangle, not Downtown, not DC, not Capitol, not Washington.

98 unique passenger-open Metrorail stops on the official map after dedupe across shared trunks. Recent openings that ARE on this map: Potomac Yard (printed Potomac Yard + VT subtitle → Potomac Yard-VT); Silver Line through to Ashburn (Wiehle-Reston East is a through stop, not the far end); Downtown Largo (not Largo Town Center); North Bethesda (not White Flint); Hyattsville Crossing (not Prince George's Plaza); Tysons (not Tysons Corner). No unopened / future station the map does not print as open was inserted.

Two-line map labels concatenated for D1 strings (primary + historic/campus subtitle the map prints): Woodley Park-Zoo/Adams Morgan; Gallery Place-Chinatown (map prints Gallery Place, not Gallery Pl); Rhode Island Av-Brentwood; Addison Rd-Seat Pleasant; U St/African-Amer Civil War Mem'l/Cardozo; Mt Vernon Sq/7th St-Convention Center; Archives-Navy Mem'l-Penn Quarter; Vienna/Fairfax-GMU; Dunn Loring-Merrifield; West Falls Church-VT (map subtitle VT only — not VT/UVA); Potomac Yard-VT. Landmark-only subtitles Kennedy Center (under Foggy Bottom-GWU) and National Mall (under Smithsonian) are NOT part of the stop string. Grosvenor - Strathmore keeps the map spaces around the hyphen.

Yellow legend is Huntington / Mt Vernon Sq & Greenbelt. Dashed yellow = Served by every other train on the Green trunk to Greenbelt. Yellow stations[] includes that full run. shortTurns records Mt Vernon Sq/7th St-Convention Center. Yellow does not serve Arlington Cemetery or Rosslyn.

Silver legend is Ashburn / Downtown Largo & New Carrollton. stations[] is the Ashburn–Downtown Largo path (34). New Carrollton is a second eastern terminus sharing Orange east of Stadium-Armory (Minnesota Av, Deanwood, Cheverly, Landover, New Carrollton).
Farragut North (Red) is NOT Farragut West (Orange/Blue/Silver). Gallery Place-Chinatown is NOT Metro Center. Do not merge.
